attacks.claim: The QA table reports a completed staff pilot week (64 cards, real holds, 0 misdelivered texts, 2 copy fixes re-verified). The Rollout section schedules that pilot for Nov 2-6, and today is 2026-10-26, so it has not happened. The pass result that gates the all-cardholder launch is unsupported by any real run.
attacks.evidence: QA table: "Staff pilot week (64 staff cards, real holds) | 0 misdelivered texts; 2 copy fixes shipped and re-verified" vs Rollout: "1. Nov 2-6: flags on for staff cards only (pilot above)."

attacks.claim: The announcement says text alerts are "for every cardholder", but juvenile cards do not show the SMS option. Guardians must opt in with their own number on a linked guardian account, so the claim overpromises and may confuse families.
attacks.evidence: Announcement: "Text alerts for holds, for every cardholder." vs "juvenile cards do not show it"

attacks.claim: Nothing addresses reassigned or wrong phone numbers after a patron confirms. The SMS carries the locker location and a pickup code, so a stale number would leak that to a stranger. The card-plus-code requirement limits the harm.
attacks.evidence: ABSENT: reassigned-number handling or periodic re-confirmation
